title: The v1 '~45 percent of countries are democracies' figure is unsourced
summary: Freedom House and V-Dem publish counts. Neither count was successfully read.
body: The v1 democracy article says about 45 percent of countries are democracies, that democracy spread after the 1970s, and that backsliding is a recent concern. Those are time-stamped empirical claims. A Freedom House page loaded without a usable country count. A guessed V-Dem PDF URL 404'd. Leave the percentage unsourced. Any future card should name the dataset, the year, and the definition of "democracy," because the indexes disagree.

legacy.note: v1 truthScore and source-count fields are not evidence and are not copied.
